description: Ministry of Defence- Amended the Sri Lanka Army Women's Carps Regulations 1987 Extra Gazette No.528/15 October 21, 1988.
categorisation: This gazette contains regulations made by the Minister of Defence under the Army Act, specifically amending the Sri Lanka Army Women's Corps Regulations. It involves legal/regulatory amendments to existing military regulations, which falls under Legal/Regulatory Gazettes (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments and regulatory modifications rather than government personnel changes or organizational restructuring.
